blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Levanga Hokkaido’s Filipino import Dwight Ramos will captain the Asia All-Stars at the 2027 Japan B.League All-Star Week after emerging as the team’s top vote-getter. The B.League announced Thursday that Ramos will lead the Asia All-Stars in the Sports Depo All-Star Asia Cross Tournament, which will also feature several other Filipino imports.
